current_findings: Ross 2011 provides the cleanest first physical prototype candidate in the Ross lineage
the finite-volume continuity algebra conserves mass to roundoff across 1 to 128 cells and sigma 0, 0.5 and 1 without global nonlinear iteration
the committed test base state remains bitwise unchanged in continuity and tangent algebra gates
a discrete bottom response tangent can be obtained algebraically from the same tridiagonal factorization with one additional O(N) backsolve in the analytic linear fixture
the tangent agrees with symmetric boundary perturbation reference trials to a maximum precommitted metric of 1.26885786529119e-10
none of these algebra gates qualifies real SWAP face tables, saturation switching, physical groundwater head semantics or MODFLOW coupling
next_action: Qualify a real precomputed steady-Darcian face table against the shared authoritative face oracle, first for unsaturated homogeneous SWAP hydraulic fixtures and unseen interpolation probes. Only after that physical face representation passes should J1 apply the already-qualified same-factorization tangent construction to real table derivatives and regime-switch fail-closed checks.
